name: Princess Must Die!
summary: At Stonefield Farm, Ma Stonefield wants Princess Must Die! before Princess ruins the harvest. The enormous prize-winning sow from Brackwell Pumpkin Patch keeps raiding the Stonefields’ vegetables, and Ma wants the family to gather their crops in peace.

sections.title: A Menace to the Harvest
sections.body: Princess has put the Stonefield harvest at risk. The prize-winning sow belongs to the Brackwells, but she has grown enormous by crossing onto the Stonefield plots and devouring their vegetables. Ma Stonefield has had enough of the sow eating the crops she worked to grow. She wants Princess put down before the pig ruins the season’s yield.

sections.title: The Porcine Entourage
sections.body: Princess does not roam alone. At Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, east beyond the Maclure homestead, protective boars surround her. To prove the sow will trouble the Stonefield fields no more, you need to get past her guards and bring back the distinctive brass collar from her neck.

faq.answer: Princess is an enormous, prize-winning sow belonging to the Brackwell family. She grew so large by sneaking onto Stonefield Farm and gorging on Ma Stonefield’s vegetables.

faq.q: Why does Ma Stonefield want Princess killed?
faq.answer: Princess keeps wandering into Ma Stonefield’s fields and devouring the vegetables. Ma fears the sow will eat the family’s entire harvest, so she hires travelers to slay Princess and bring back her brass collar as proof.
Princess can be found at Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in southeastern Elwynn Forest, east beyond the Maclure Vineyards. She roams among the ruined pumpkins with boars guarding her.

faq.q: Who owns the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch?
faq.answer: The Brackwell family owns Brackwell Pumpkin Patch. Bandits and wild beasts have brought hard times to the local farmers and their lands in southern Elwynn Forest. Though the family has neglected the patch, Princess stayed behind to gorge on what remained.

faq.q: How do you prove Princess is dead?
faq.answer: To prove Princess is dead, bring the Brass Collar from around her neck to Ma Stonefield at Stonefield Farm.
No. Defensive boars called the Porcine Entourage accompany Princess and attack anyone who tries to slay the prize sow.

angles.text: Princess’s great size has become a tale among local cooks. Elwynn’s oversized boars yield plenty of hearty meat for roasting over an open fire.
As an Alliance traveler, you help farmers like Ma Stonefield keep rogue beasts from threatening Stormwind’s southern breadbasket, even while the kingdom’s formal army is absent.
